about: With over 39 years of experience in the legal field, Bradley C. Gage is a well-established attorney and founder of Brad Gage Law, APC, located in Woodland Hills, California. Representing clients throughout Los Angeles and statewide, his areas of proficiency include:

Mr. Gage is licensed to practice in all California state courts, as well as the U.S. District Court for the Southern and Central Districts of California, the U.S. Court of Appeals for the 5th and 9th Circuits. With an impressive track record, he has represented leading public figures such as judges, politicians, city managers and police chiefs, culminating in approximately 40 settlements and trials over one million dollars ($1,000,000.00) and occasionally exceeding ten million dollars ($10,000,000.00). He has also taken part in various class actions with other law firms, resulting in recoveries totaling over five billion dollars ($5,000,000,000.)

Among Mr. Gage's high-profile cases, he successfully represented LAPD Officer John Futrell in the North Hollywood Shootout civil rights lawsuit brought by the bank robbers' family. He also acted for the family of the late rapper Notorious B.I.G. in a civil rights lawsuit against the LAPD, which resulted in the City being obliged to pay over 1,000,000.00 in sanctions. Additionally, he reportedly achieved the most substantial judgment ever recorded in Burbank Superior Court at the time and purportedly secured the second-largest victory in United States history in a case involving First Amendment retaliation against the Los Angeles County Sheriff's Department.

Mr. Gage attained his Bachelor of Science in business administration from the University of Southern California, Los Angeles, California, in 1981. He then obtained his J.D. from the University of San Francisco School of Law in 1984.

Having been bestowed an "Excellent" rating on Avvo, Mr. Gage has been acknowledged in "Who's Who in North America". His exceptional work in sexual orientation discrimination led him to receive nominations as one of the top U.S. Lawyers by the Elite Lawyers Organization. Notably, he is recognized as an advocate level holder in the American Board of Trial Advocates (ABOTA). Mr. Gage was selected as Attorney of the Year three times (2020, 2021 and 2023) by various organizations and nominated six times as Trial Lawyer of the Year. He has been selected 11 times as one of the Top 100 Plaintiffs Civil Lawyers in North America.
